compiler_only_output.reason: mwccarm emits the base-object destructor beside the licensed D1/D0 pair. The cartridge has no D2 for this class -- ov085 runs D1 at 0x0212cc88 straight into D0 at 0x0212ccc0 and then into func_ov085_0212cd0c, with no third variant in the overlay's delinks partition and no symbol of that name configured in any module -- so there is no configured home and no surviving relocation references it.

func_ov085_0212d2b8 declares a Vector3 local, so this TU re-emits Vector3's vague-linkage D1 alongside its own text. The cartridge keeps one copy at arm9:0x020072c0, and src/_ZN7Vector3D1Ev.cpp already owns it as a complete .text 0x020072c0..0x020072c4 range; rombuild compares this object's body against those cartridge bytes and refuses anything but byte-identical vague-linkage output before discarding the duplicate.

This TU owns daObj_Mip_Key_c's key function -- ~daObj_Mip_Key_c is the first declared non-inline virtual and its body is out of line here; inherited virtual overrides remain virtual without repeating the keyword -- so mwcc emits the complete 0x84-byte class vtable storage with its ABI preamble. The cartridge's storage begins at ov085:0x021301d0, where offset-to-top is 0 and the next word points at _ZTI15daObj_Mip_Key_c (0x02130194); the public address point recorded in symbols.txt is 0x021301d8, eight bytes above the start of storage and outside this text-only entry's licensed range, so dsd supplies that ROM data independently. Storage runs 0x021301d0..0x02130254, which is exactly 0x84 and closes on the next configured datum.
